```{r}
#| include: false
theme_set(theme_classic(base_size = 16, base_family = "HiraginoSans-W3"))
theme_update(
  panel.background      = element_rect(fill = "transparent"),
  plot.background       = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
  legend.background     = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
  legend.box.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
  strip.background      = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
  strip.text            = element_text(siee = 18)
)

theme_jay <- function(font = "HiraginoSans-W3",
                      size = 16) {
  theme_classic(base_family = font, base_size = size) +
    theme(plot.title            = element_text(size = size * 1.5, hjust = 0.5),
          plot.subtitle         = element_text(size = size * 1.2),
          legend.position       = "bottom",
          plot.title.position   = "plot",
          panel.background      = element_rect(fill = "transparent"),
          plot.background       = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
          legend.background     = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
          legend.box.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
          strip.background      = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
          strip.text            = element_text(size = size * 1.2))
}
```
